metadata.title: Measurement Theory Foundations — Sources
metadata.description: Primary sources for the bounded foundation workflow; synthetic examples are not empirical findings.

primary_sources.name: Standards for Educational and Psychological Testing
primary_sources.author: AERA, APA, NCME
primary_sources.scope: Chapters 1–3: validity, reliability/precision, fairness; publication and relevant text read. A revision committee is working on a new edition; check testingstandards.net before calling this edition current.
primary_sources.verified_via: Primary PDF opened and relevant passages inspected on 2026-09-17

primary_sources.name: JCGM 200:2012 International vocabulary of metrology
primary_sources.author: JCGM
primary_sources.scope: Measurement, calibration, uncertainty, traceability vocabulary; calibration passages inspected.

primary_sources.name: JCGM 100:2008 Evaluation of measurement data
primary_sources.author: JCGM
primary_sources.scope: Physical measurement uncertainty reference; no universal psychometric cutoff asserted. The JCGM series also includes JCGM 100:2008/Amd.1:2026 (nonlinearity in measurement models), GUM-1:2023 and GUM-5:2026; check the BIPM JCGM publications page for later parts.
primary_sources.verified_via: Primary PDF opened on 2026-09-17; BIPM JCGM publications page re-checked on 2026-09-23; BIPM JCGM publications page re-checked 2026-09-27 (Amd.1:2026, GUM-1:2023, GUM-5:2026, GUM-6:2020 listed)

primary_sources.name: Measurement Invariance, Factor Analysis and Factorial Invariance
primary_sources.author: William Meredith
primary_sources.scope: Primary publisher abstract verifies measurement/factorial invariance distinctions. Full article not read; no numeric fit criteria or theorem magnitude attributed.
primary_sources.verified_via: Publisher abstract and 1993 volume/issue inspected on 2026-09-17; 2025 online migration date is not original publication date

primary_sources.name: JCGM GUM-6:2020 Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement — Part 6: Developing and using measurement models
primary_sources.author: JCGM
primary_sources.verified_via: Listed on the BIPM JCGM publications page, 2026-09-23

primary_sources.name: Generalizability Theory
primary_sources.author: Robert L. Brennan
primary_sources.scope: G-study/D-study concepts, facets, relative vs absolute error. Cited for concepts only; no figures attributed.
primary_sources.verified_via: Crossref metadata checked 2026-09-23; book text not re-read this session

primary_sources.name: Test Equating, Scaling, and Linking (3rd ed.)
primary_sources.author: Michael J. Kolen, Robert L. Brennan
primary_sources.scope: Common-item and common-person linking designs. Cited for concepts only; no figures attributed.
primary_sources.verified_via: Crossref metadata checked 2026-09-23; book text not re-read this session

primary_sources.name: Measuring what Matters: Construct Validity in Large Language Model Benchmarks
primary_sources.author: Bean et al.
primary_sources.scope: NeurIPS 2025 D&B. 29 reviewers, 445 benchmarks, eight recommendations (headings verbatim from HTML section titles); "16.0% used uncertainty estimates or statistical tests" verified verbatim in the arXiv v1 body.
primary_sources.verified_via: arXiv abstract read via export.arxiv.org API on 2026-09-23; HTML v1 grepped for headings and 16.0% on 2026-09-23; abstract re-read via export.arxiv.org API 2026-09-27

primary_sources.author: Salaudeen et al.
primary_sources.scope: Qualitative claim-to-evidence validity framework; no figures cited.

primary_sources.name: Global MMLU: Understanding and Addressing Cultural and Linguistic Biases in Multilingual Evaluation
primary_sources.author: Singh et al.
primary_sources.scope: 28% culturally sensitive questions; rankings change on culturally sensitive subset. Cross-language DIF exemplar.

primary_sources.name: Hidden Measurement Error in LLM Pipelines Distorts Annotation, Evaluation, and Benchmarking
primary_sources.author: Solomon Messing
primary_sources.scope: Unrefereed preprint. Naive SEs 40-60% smaller than TEE-corrected SEs in its demonstrations; single-study result.
primary_sources.verified_via: arXiv abstract read via export.arxiv.org API on 2026-09-23; abstract re-read via export.arxiv.org API 2026-09-27

primary_sources.name: Second-Order Response Laws for LLM Judges: Debiased Estimation of Prompt Instability
primary_sources.author: Feng et al.
primary_sources.scope: Unrefereed preprint. Plug-in prompt-instability estimator biased upward at finite repeats; crossed prompt x answer-order design.
primary_sources.verified_via: arXiv abstract read via export.arxiv.org API on 2026-09-23; abstract re-read via export.arxiv.org API 2026-09-27

primary_sources.name: Problems of Monetary Management: The UK Experience
primary_sources.author: Charles A. E. Goodhart
primary_sources.scope: Origin of Goodhart's law (statistical regularities collapse under control pressure). Cited for the concept only; the 1975 paper was not opened, so no quotation is reproduced in prose.
primary_sources.verified_via: Secondary only: Wikipedia entry read 2026-09-27; primary (Papers in Monetary Economics, Reserve Bank of Australia) not opened

primary_sources.name: Assessing the impact of planned social change
primary_sources.author: Donald T. Campbell
primary_sources.scope: Origin of Campbell's law (indicators used for decision-making become subject to corruption pressure). Cited for the concept only; no quotation reproduced in prose.
primary_sources.verified_via: Secondary only: Wikipedia entry and web search results 2026-09-27; Evaluation and Program Planning 2(1):67-90 not opened
